data.explanation: This is an appointment confirmation from an eye clinic following a referral. You need to show up on 8 December 2026 at 09:40 at the registration desk on the 2nd floor. Bring your glasses and a current list of your medications. Because your pupils will be dilated during the exam, you won't be able to drive yourself afterward for a few hours, so plan to come with someone or use public transport. If you can't make it, contact the clinic beforehand to reschedule.
